repos_data.description: MCP server providing access to the comprehensive OpenNutrition food database with 300,000+ food items, nutritional data, and barcode lookups
Web application that manage food recipes with simplicity

Project-aware collection management based on Qdrant, including a Rust MCP, daemon and CLI: hybrid semantic, pattern and full-text (FTS5) search into single or cross-concerns collection. Dedicated collections for knowledge library, LLM behavioral rules, and an LLM scratchpad
The AI-native database built for LLM applications, providing incredibly fast hybrid search of dense vector, sparse vector, tensor (multi-vector), and full-text.
A Collaborative Recipe Keeper, Meal Planner, and Shopping List Organizer in PWA form.
Semantic search over 4.6 million text chunks from 20,000 classical philosophy and humanities works. Built for AI agents using FastMCP.
Local RAG MCP server for Claude Code — hybrid search (semantic + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, 13 MCP tools, 20 format parsers. Zero external servers, zero API keys.
Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs -- 5-strategy scraping, runs without API keys.
Durable hybrid memory for AI agents: vector + BM25 + temporal + graph recall, exposed through MCP, HTTP, and Python.
RAG-over-a-corpus MCP server. search_knowledge returns cited passages (source + heading + chunk index). Fully local, $0 embeddings, ChromaDB, incremental ingest.

MCP server for the full Pāli Tipiṭaka — ~444,000 segments at parity with SuttaCentral (Sutta + Vinaya + Abhidhamma). Hybrid search, full-sutta fetch with cross-references, segment-aligned translation comparison, and Pāli word lookup. Offered as Dhamma Dāna.
This project is a web analysis summary MCP server project.

repo_meta_data.description: A production-grade semantic search server for food recipes — built for AI agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Search across 50,000+ recipes with hybrid dense + sparse retrieval and cross-encoder reranking.
